CREATE TABLE `owners` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`identityNumber` varchar(20),
	`phone` varchar(20),
	`email` varchar(320),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `owners_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `properties` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`deedNumber` varchar(50),
	`deedType` varchar(100),
	`ownerId` int,
	`ownerIdentity` varchar(20),
	`ownerName` varchar(255),
	`propertyType` enum('فيلا','شقة','عمارة','مكتب','محل','مستودع','أرض','أخرى') DEFAULT 'أخرى',
	`propertyUsage` varchar(100),
	`city` varchar(100),
	`region` varchar(100),
	`address` text,
	`totalUnits` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalContracts` int DEFAULT 0,
	`reservedUnits` int DEFAULT 0,
	`rentedUnits` int DEFAULT 0,
	`availableUnits` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalContractAmount` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalDocumentationFees` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalBrokerageFees` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `properties_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `units` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`propertyId` int,
	`propertyName` varchar(255),
	`unitNumber` varchar(50),
	`unitType` enum('شقة','فيلا','استوديو','غرفة','مكتب','محل','مستودع','أخرى') DEFAULT 'شقة',
	`floor` varchar(20),
	`area` decimal(10,2),
	`rooms` int,
	`bathrooms` int,
	`status` enum('متاحة','مؤجرة','محجوزة','تحت_الصيانة') DEFAULT 'متاحة',
	`rentPrice` decimal(15,2),
	`city` varchar(100),
	`region` varchar(100),
	`deedNumber` varchar(50),
	`ownerName` varchar(255),
	`ownerIdentity` varchar(20),
	`notes` text,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `units_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `maintenance_requests` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`requestNumber` varchar(50),
	`propertyId` int,
	`propertyName` varchar(255),
	`unitId` int,
	`unitNumber` varchar(50),
	`contractId` int,
	`tenantName` varchar(255),
	`tenantPhone` varchar(20),
	`category` enum('كهرباء','سباكة','تكييف','نجارة','دهان','نظافة','أمن','أخرى') DEFAULT 'أخرى',
	`title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`priority` enum('عاجل','عالي','متوسط','منخفض') DEFAULT 'متوسط',
	`status` enum('جديد','قيد_المعالجة','منتظر_الموافقة','مكتمل','ملغي') DEFAULT 'جديد',
	`assignedTo` varchar(255),
	`estimatedCost` decimal(15,2),
	`actualCost` decimal(15,2),
	`requestDate` timestamp NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`completionDate` timestamp NULL,
	`notes` text,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `maintenance_requests_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
